changes.subject: Dependency-free portable-path qualification
changes.before: The WA-007 owned subtree contained no executable scanner or declared closure semantics.
changes.after: portable_path_scanner.py recursively scans explicit UTF-8 roots, emits stable path categories and coordinates, hashes every scanned file, records every exclusion, and fails closed on incomplete closure.
recurrence_evidence: 22 focused tests passed in Python isolated mode.
23/23 labelled positive cases were detected with every required category.
Closure tests reject binary, invalid UTF-8, symlink, duplicate-root, missing-root, and invalid-checkout conditions.

changes.subject: Dot-relative false-positive repair
changes.before: The first implementation entered at the slash inside ./ and ../ portable relative paths, producing 2/44 false positives.
changes.after: Generic slash-rooted matching rejects a slash immediately preceded by a dot, while absolute tokens separated by whitespace or punctuation remain eligible.

changes.subject: Immutable result-custody readback
changes.before: Scanner output had no unit-local verifier for byte-exact remote result custody.
changes.after: verify_remote_readback.py fetches a named branch into a fresh repository, requires the exact expected tip, reads each manifest artifact with git show at the full commit, and compares SHA-256 plus bytes.
recurrence_evidence: Fresh-repository payload and manifest readback passed.
Wrong manifest digest, branch movement, and parent traversal cases fail closed.
